# secureaccess_zta_profile_group_mappings (Resource)

This resource manages a ZTA Profile Group Mappings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_zta_profile_group_mappings" "example" {
  zta_profile_id = "acde070d-8c4c-4f0d-9d8a-162843c10333"
  groups = [
    {
      id = "12345678"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `groups` (Attributes Set) List of groups mapped to the ZTA Profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `zta_profile_id` (String) ID of the ZTA Profile.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_zta_profile_group_mappings.example "<zta_profile_id>"
```
